# Vendored frontend assets

- `echarts.min.js`: Apache ECharts 5.5.1, Apache-2.0 license.
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@5.5.1/dist/echarts.min.js
- `lucide.min.js`: Lucide 0.468.0, ISC license.
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide@0.468.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js

These files are stored locally so the course demo does not depend on a CDN.
